sql: SELECT T2.birth_region FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.role = 'assistant location manager'
SELECT T2.role FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.name = 'Julia Roberts' AND T2.result = 'Nominee'
SELECT T1.title, T1.summary, T1.air_date FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Vote AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.stars = 10 AND T2.votes = 72

SELECT T1.name, T2.role FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.award = 'Best Television Episode' AND T2.award_category = 'Edgar' AND T2.year = 2000 AND T2.result = 'Winner'

SELECT T2.year, T2.episode_id FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.name = 'Constantine Makris' AND T2.result = 'Winner' AND T2.award = 'Television' AND T2.award_category = 'Silver Gavel Award' AND T2.organization = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts'

SELECT COUNT(T2.award_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.episode = 20 AND T2.series = 'Law and Order' AND T2.organization = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND T2.year = 1999 AND T2.result = 'Nominee'

SELECT T3.episode_id, T2.role FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id INNER JOIN Episode AS T3 ON T2.episode_id = T3.episode_id WHERE T1.name = 'Julia Roberts' AND T2.award = 'Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series' AND T2.year = 1999 AND T2.organization = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND T2.result = 'Winner'

SELECT T1.title, T1.air_date FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id INNER JOIN Person AS T3 ON T3.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T3.name = 'Billy Fox' AND T2.role = 'producer'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.birth_country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.role), T1.role FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id INNER JOIN Episode AS T3 ON T1.episode_id = T3.episode_id WHERE T3.episode = 2 AND T1.category = 'Cast'
SELECT T3.name FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id INNER JOIN Person AS T3 ON T3.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.episode = 9
SELECT DISTINCT T1.episode_id FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.result = 'Nominee'
SELECT SUM(rating) / COUNT(episode_id) FROM Episode WHERE season = 9
SELECT T1.rating FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.result = 'Winner' GROUP BY T1.episode_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.episode FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.keyword = 'mafia'
SELECT birth_country FROM Person WHERE name = 'Michael Preston'
SELECT T1.title FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.award = 'Outstanding Costume Design for a Series'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birth_place FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.person_id = 'nm0007064' AND T2.role = 'Narrator' AND T2.credited = 'false'
